name: BoxWherever
summary:
Box to your music, wherever you want to be.

BoxWherever turns a supported DRM-free song from your personal library into a customized VR boxing workout. Choose a compatible real-world 360 scene, set the exact view you want to face when the music begins, adjust the intensity, then step into the round on Meta Quest.
